---
title: "Chapters"
---

```{r}
#| label: chapters-load
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
metadata <- read_csv("data/chapter_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stats <- read_csv("data/processed/chapter_stats.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
chapter_table <- metadata %>%
  left_join(stats %>% select(chapter, word_count, char_count), by = "chapter") %>%
  select(chapter, chapter_title, approx_start_year, approx_end_year, life_stage,
         primary_locations, word_count, date_confidence, notes)
```

This table is the first version of the chapter metadata layer. The year ranges are initial estimates and should be reviewed against the memoir before final timeline claims.

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(chapter_table, options = list(pageLength = 12, scrollX = TRUE))
```

## Chapter files

The chapter-split text files are generated into:

```text
data/processed/chapters/chapter_01.md
...
data/processed/chapters/chapter_11.md
```

Chapter 12 is a full-text reference and is excluded from timeline charts by default.
